approximate_size: 435 character rows (216 English, 219 Russian), about 8,700 nested dialogues; 396 MB including images.
provenance: Named GPT-4 character/topic generation; first dialogue per character GPT-4, remaining 19 GPT-3.5. Better documented than scraped cards; generator terms still need evidence.
conversation_format: context, greeting, example_dialogue, dialogues[{chat, model_name, topic}], image fields.
multi_turn_depth: First two English rows: 20 chats each, 4–9 messages/chat. Read first chat of each; counted all 40.
quality_indications: Distinct original fox/cactus personas and consistent voice; inspected chats are lore interviews, not enacted scenes.
composition: Observed SFW fantasy; adult fraction unknown.
major_risks: Short exchanges, generic exposition; fictional nonhuman age needs contextual handling. Images and example dialogue must stay separate.
smoke_100_recommendation: YES, highest-priority new character-voice diagnostic: text-only 100 conversations across distinct characters, preserve parent IDs; not 100 character rows/2,000 chats.

approximate_size: Episode JSONL 75.3 MB; episode count not verified. Viewer 33,410 rows are Social-IQA prompts, not episodes.
provenance: Official research release: generated interactions and model/reward metadata; inspirations from Social-IQA, Social-Chemistry and NormBank require separate upstream checks.
conversation_format: Episode IDs, profiles, private goals, social_interactions, raw_messages, rewards/reasoning.
multi_turn_depth: Two pinned episodes: 8 and 9 spoken messages plus nonverbal/exit actions.
quality_indications: Useful goal conflict and negotiation structure. First example swaps speaker identity; second reaches compromise then loops. Scores do not establish quality.
composition: Observed SFW social situations; not evidence of adult RP.
major_risks: CC BY-SA obligations and upstream rights need assessment. Hidden goals, evaluator reasoning and model prompts are not transcript targets. Keep evaluation episodes separate.
smoke_100_recommendation: YES, second priority, only episode file with model-tag stratification and held-out evaluation IDs; pending provenance. Do not ingest viewer default.

approximate_size: 1,486,896 dialogues; train 1,191,582. About 856 MB of parquet.
provenance: InstructGPT synthesis from Atomic10x commonsense; documented narrative-to-dialogue generation and source indices. Upstream/generator rights not verified here.
conversation_format: dialogue + parallel speakers, narrative, commonsense triples, source indices, semantic consistency labels.
multi_turn_depth: Two preview rows: 6 and 11 spoken messages.
quality_indications: Coherent social exchange; second develops a work/relationship concern. Little distinctive character voice or enacted scene movement.
composition: Observed SFW; mature/emotional situations possible, explicit-adult proportion unknown.
major_risks: Generic advice, narratives can disclose future events or internal states; role mapping and label reliability need inspection.
smoke_100_recommendation: OPTIONAL later 100-row SFW continuity baseline; not a primary RP source. Keep narrative/reward metadata out of assistant targets.

provenance: Card documents Faker-generated identities, procedural social variables and Gemma-4-E4B-it generation.
conversation_format: JSON strings context/prompt/output; output contains inferred_scenario and speaker/line dialogue.
quality_indications: Boundary-setting example makes a concrete communication-frequency concession; second is static status banter.
composition: Observed SFW; personal/intimate scenario category is not an adult-content label.
major_risks: Generation directives contaminate naive ingestion. Repeated hesitation and static emotions; context/medium mismatch in row 1; limited physical action.
smoke_100_recommendation: OPTIONAL later 100-row SFW social-boundary baseline, lower priority than character-focused inspection.

approximate_size: 21,907 conversations: 10,906 with original profiles plus 11,001 with new synthetic personas; about 38.4 MB CSV.
provenance: Official Generator-Critic release seeded from Persona-Chat; new-persona branch preferable, with seed/generation rights still pending.
conversation_format: CSV persona strings and speaker-labelled conversation string; repository names differ from simplified card schema.
multi_turn_depth: Two existing-persona train previews: 19 and 25 spoken lines.
quality_indications: Friendly rapport but little scene development; name placeholders in row 0 and repeated agreement in row 1.
composition: Observed SFW social chat; no verified adult slice.
major_risks: Weak persona coverage, generic agreement, train/test leakage risk. New-persona branch not row-inspected here.
smoke_100_recommendation: NO for the next RP smoke queue; reserve for future persona consistency comparisons, not the scene corpus.

approximate_size: 2,770 rows; 63.0 MB parquet, 117.7 MB logical data.
provenance: Synthetic RPBuild; Roleplay TTL seeds, Mistral-7B metadata, RolePlayLake-7B actors/director. Seed identities and model chain need checks.
conversation_format: conversation plus proxy, character metadata, example_dialog, scenario and director_log.
multi_turn_depth: Card targets at least 4,000 tokens; two previews have 20/19 messages including system.
quality_indications: Designed for progression, but first preview repeats partnership backstories; second circles nature/technology and narrates the proxy character.
composition: Observed SFW; total adult mix unknown.
major_risks: Card acknowledges prior Alice leakage, impersonation and regex truncation. Greetings force movement; director logs can leak instructions; actual scenes lag plot outlines.
smoke_100_recommendation: NO now. Keep methodology as a research lead; two previews reproduce current failure modes.

provenance: Gemini Pro character generation stated; mixed original and established identities. Preview includes a living public figure despite original-persona framing.
conversation_format: name, description, text with system/user/assistant delimiter tokens.
multi_turn_depth: Card 3–5 exchanges; both previews have 4 user/assistant pairs.
quality_indications: Sherlock lore questions; Serena Williams third-person biography answers. Neither demonstrates scene progression.
major_risks: Real-person identity mix, repetitive ornate exposition, wrapper conversion needed; voice claims not representative in two previews.
smoke_100_recommendation: NO for first positive RP corpus; avoid as an unquestioned original-character seed.

approximate_size: Card says over 10,000 entries; gzip 8.77 MB.
provenance: Card describes GPT-4-generated scenarios, characters, dialogue and omniscient summaries.
conversation_format: setting, characters, conversation[{from,message}], setting after interaction.
multi_turn_depth: Both pinned raw preview rows have 6 lines across 3 characters; card example also 6.

major_risks: Too few turns per character, omniscient agency, generic reassurance; viewer fails, so use explicit raw schema if revisited.
smoke_100_recommendation: NO for this corpus; does not supply demonstrated interactive scene quality.

provenance: Creator claims original writing plus AI-generated material from various unnamed models and historical/scholarly inspirations.
multi_turn_depth: Card explicitly describes two-message pairs; two previews confirm this.
quality_indications: Recognizable mystic voice, but no cross-turn continuity or consent/progression evidence.
composition: Card declares erotic/adult content; first two rows are non-explicit. Viewer age warning does not establish participant ages.
major_risks: Single persona and single turns; unclear model lineage, added card use conditions, unverified source/participant details.
smoke_100_recommendation: NO. Better creator attribution than anonymous scrapes, but not an adult multi-turn solution.

approximate_size: 771 novels; training JSON 2.22 GB; full repository about 2.62 GB. Card has 200 test samples; training row count unverified.

multi_turn_depth: Card describes multi-turn/multi-character literary conversations; no raw text fetched.
quality_indications: Potential literary continuity, but scripted literature is not evidence of interactive user agency.
composition: Genre-dependent; safety truncations reported, adult proportions unknown.
major_risks: Direct literary provenance conflicts with this task’s source preference; internal-state/omniscient narration and book contamination.
